description: Standard graph and model operators for OMLE v0.1.

input_kinds.tensor: Any named graph value with tensor shape [N, ...].
input_kinds.matrix: A tensor with shape [N, D] for some statically known D.
input_kinds.numeric_tensor: A tensor with shape [N, ...] and numeric dtype (integer or floating-point).
input_kinds.floating_tensor: A tensor with shape [N, ...] and floating-point dtype.
input_kinds.integer_tensor: A tensor with shape [N, ...] and integer dtype (signed or unsigned).
input_kinds.boolean_tensor: A tensor with shape [N, ...] and BOOL dtype.
input_kinds.string_tensor: A tensor with shape [N, ...] and STRING dtype.
input_kinds.sparse_tensor: A sparse tensor value with a declared dense shape [N, ...].
input_kinds.token_sequence: A per-row token sequence value used by text operators.
input_kinds.label_set_sequence: A per-row collection of zero or more labels.

type_rules.same_type(x): Return the same tensor dtype as input x.
type_rules.same_type(xs): All tensors in xs must have the same dtype; output uses that dtype.
type_rules.same_type(candidates): All candidate tensors must have the same dtype; output uses that dtype.
type_rules.same_type_as_all_inputs: All inputs must have the same dtype; output uses that dtype.
type_rules.promote_to_float(x): Return FLOAT32 or FLOAT64 depending on x and operator policy.
type_rules.promote_to_float(inputs): Return a float dtype appropriate for the numeric inputs.
type_rules.same_type(attr:output_dtype): Return the dtype named by the output_dtype attribute.
type_rules.floating_type(attr:output_dtype): Return the floating-point dtype named by the output_dtype attribute.
type_rules.derived_from_expression(expr): Infer dtype from the embedded Expression and function registry.
type_rules.derived_from_body: Infer dtype from the structured body contract.
type_rules.dense_value_type(x): Return the value dtype of sparse input x as the dtype of the dense output.
type_rules.dense_to_sparse_value_type(x): Return the dtype of dense input x as the value dtype of the sparse output.
type_rules.derived_from_knn_targets: Infer dtype from the stored KNN target tensor and task.

shape_rules.same_shape(x): Return the same shape as x.
shape_rules.same_shape_as_all_inputs: All inputs must have the same shape; output uses that shape.
shape_rules.concat_last_dim(inputs): Concatenate inputs along the last dimension.
shape_rules.replace_last_dim(x,K): Keep all dimensions except replace the last dimension with K.
shape_rules.split_last_dim(x,sections): Split x along the last dimension into outputs whose last-dimension sizes are given by sections.
shape_rules.reshape_preserve_rows(x,new_shape): Return shape [N, ...new_shape], preserving the leading row dimension.
shape_rules.same_shape_as_candidates: All candidate inputs must have the same shape; output uses that shape.
shape_rules.same_dense_shape(x): Return the declared dense shape of sparse input x.
shape_rules.sparse_shape_from_dense(x): Return a sparse tensor whose declared dense shape matches the shape of dense input x.
shape_rules.token_sequence: Return one token sequence per input row.
shape_rules.token_sequence_variable: Return one token sequence per input row; token count per row may vary independently of the input.
shape_rules.derived_from_body: Infer shape from the structured body contract.
shape_rules.derived_from_input_and_operator: Infer output shape from input shapes and the operator contract.

measure_level_rules.derived_from_input_and_operator: Derived from input semantics and operator contract.
measure_level_rules.derived_from_expression(expr): Infer measure level from the embedded Expression and function registry.
measure_level_rules.derived_from_body: Infer measure level from the structured body contract.
measure_level_rules.derived_from_knn_targets: For classification use NOMINAL; for regression use CONTINUOUS.

domain_rules.binary_0_1: Output domain is the discrete set {0,1}.
domain_rules.copied_from_input: Output domain matches the relevant input domain.
